name: Eagles

whyMatters.en: LA session-grade country-rock that hardened into Hotel California (1976) dual-lead hard-rock AOR: Take It Easy to Hotel California maps soft harmony into stadium guitar grammar.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶录音室级 country-rock 硬化成 Hotel California（1976）双主音 hard-rock AOR：从 Take It Easy 到 Hotel California，把软和声推进体育场吉他语法。

lyricQuotes: Welcome to the Hotel California / Such a lovely place
Take it easy / Take it easy / Don't let the sound of your own wheels drive you crazy

shortBio.en: LA country-rock to Hotel California dual-lead AOR; Take It Easy as debut radio face.
shortBio.zh: 洛杉矶 country-rock 到 Hotel California 双主音 AOR；Take It Easy 作出道电台面孔。

body.en:
Formed 1971 from Linda Ronstadt’s backing circle (Frey, Henley, Leadon, Meisner). Early Eagles (1972) and Desperado (1973) sell stacked harmony and acoustic/electric country-rock. Felder joins mid-decade; Walsh replaces Leadon 1975—hard-rock guitar weight rises.

Hotel California (1976, Bill Szymczyk) is the citation LP: 12-string arpeggio intro, dual Felder/Walsh lead trade, Henley vocal. Life in the Fast Lane is the Walsh riff hard-rock track. Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) and Hotel California dominate US sales charts as soft-to-hard AOR bridge.
body.zh:
1971 年从 Linda Ronstadt 伴奏圈组建（Frey、Henley、Leadon、Meisner）。早期 Eagles（1972）与 Desperado（1973）卖叠和声与原声/电声 country-rock。Felder 十年中期加入；Walsh 1975 年替换 Leadon——hard-rock 吉他重量上升。

Hotel California（1976，Bill Szymczyk）是引用 LP：十二弦琶音 intro、Felder/Walsh 双主音对答、Henley 人声。Life in the Fast Lane 是 Walsh riff hard-rock 曲。Their Greatest Hits（1971–1975）与 Hotel California 主宰美国销量榜，作软到硬 AOR 桥。

note.zh: Jackson Browne 合写；出道单曲和声 country-rock。

note.en: 12-string arpeggio + Felder/Walsh dual-lead coda; AOR hard-rock peak.
note.zh: 十二弦琶音 + Felder/Walsh 双主音尾奏；AOR hard-rock 巅峰。

note.zh: Walsh riff 曲；Hotel California 专辑 hard-rock 锋刃。

title.zh: Country-rock 硬化成 AOR 双主音

body.en:
Eagles start as harmony country-rock from the Ronstadt pool. Felder and Walsh push Les Paul/Strat dual leads into the mix without dropping vocal stacks.

Hotel California is the hinge: mid-tempo narrative, precise studio arrangement, guitar duel as climax—not blues jam.

Craft is session discipline and FM hook length.
body.zh:
Eagles 从 Ronstadt 池子起步作和声 country-rock。Felder 与 Walsh 把 Les Paul/Strat 双主音推进混音，不丢人声叠层。

Hotel California 是铰链：中速叙事、精确录音室编排、吉他对决作高潮——非蓝调 jam。

工艺是录音室纪律与 FM 钩子长度。

body.en:
Leadon exits 1975; Walsh brings James Gang hard-rock vocabulary. Felder already on One of These Nights.

Meisner exits after Hotel California; Schmit joins for The Long Run.

Peak studio chemistry is Frey/Henley writing with Felder/Walsh leads, 1975–1979.
body.zh:
Leadon 1975 年离队；Walsh 带入 James Gang hard-rock 语汇。Felder 已在 One of These Nights。

Meisner 在 Hotel California 后离队；Schmit 加入 The Long Run。

巅峰录音室化学是 Frey/Henley 写作 + Felder/Walsh 主音，1975–1979。

title.zh: 体育场 AOR 双主音模板

body.en:
Hotel California guitar coda is a teaching track for dual-lead hard-rock AOR. Later LA and arena bands copy the polish-plus-riff mix.

Sales legacy is inseparable from the sound: Greatest Hits and Hotel California as US catalog anchors.

Influence path is production and arrangement more than punk or metal ideology.
body.zh:
Hotel California 吉他尾奏是双主音 hard-rock AOR 教材曲。后来洛杉矶与体育场乐队复制抛光+riff 混搭。

销量遗产与声音不可分：Greatest Hits 与 Hotel California 作美国目录锚。

影响路径在制作与编排，多于朋克或金属意识形态。
